description.en: This dataset contains Unified Foundational Ontology (UFO), a top-level ontology biased towards conceptual modeling support.  The ontology is represented in OWL.

example.title: Kind - An example of a UFO vocabulary term.
example.description: Kind denotes a UFO type which is a rigid sortal providing the principle of identity for its instances.

sparql.title: Sparql endpoint (RDF4J) for the current version of UFO
